Job description

We are looking for Data Analyst Freshers , Data Analytics fresher to join our growing team. This is an excellent chance for recent graduates who are passionate about data, problem-solving, and business insights.

Job Role- Data Analyst Fresher

Experience: 0- 1 Year  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities:

- Collect, clean, and analyze structured and unstructured data
- Interpret data trends and patterns to generate actionable insights
- Create reports, dashboards, and data visualizations
- Support business teams with analytical requirements
- Perform data validation and quality checks  

Skills Required:

- Basic computer knowledge
- Basic Excel knowledge (preferred)
- Good communication skills
- Basic understanding of MS Excel
- Basic knowledge of SQL is an added advantage
- Familiarity with Power BI / Tableau

Data Entry, Excel, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting, Back Office Executive, Backend Operations, Computer Operator, Data Management, Reporting, Operations Executive, Microsoft Excel (Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query) Data Analysis , Data Cleaning, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA),Statistical Analysis, Data Interpretation, SQL (MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQL Server),Python, Power BI , Tableau .

Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies .
